prompt: Design a polished, realistic native Android conversation app screenshot, a single full portrait flat screen, 412x892 dp proportions, no device casing, no poster, no surrounding scene. App Series 76 is an engineering assistant for actuator specifications. The user explicitly wants the familiar refined conversation-first pattern of Claude and Gemini, including a left slide-out conversation-history drawer, NOT an oversized dashboard or large generic cards. Original brand lilac #BD7BFF is only an accent; neutral near-white #FAFAFC main canvas, softly tinted grey #F0EFF4 sidebar and composer, charcoal #25232A text, darker grey #66616F secondary text, dark lilac #4C315E actions. Contemporary precise Android system sans typography with delicate hierarchy, no gigantic headlines. Top bar compact, hamburger at far left, Series 76 centered, a native new-conversation edit icon on the right. Main composer is an elegant large rounded soft-grey surface anchored above navigation inset, placeholder 'Ask about an actuator', a small round dark-plum upward-send-arrow button inside the right edge. No microphone, attachments, model selector, user profile, search, folders, projects, subscriptions, settings, voice, fake buttons, or added capabilities. Exactly actual chat and saved conversations, plus developer debug only off-screen in development. System Android status and gesture bars legible dark on light. No copied Claude/Gemini logo or star symbol. Content minimal but product-specific; this is a credible focused product, not a blank wireframe. Strong craft, careful 20dp gutters, thin separators only where meaningful, restrained shadows, readable 48dp controls, generous negative space. State ONE: starting a new chat, drawer CLOSED. No messages yet. Near upper-middle a small lilac rounded square containing a simple '76' monogram, then a calm 30sp medium weight two-line question 'What would you like\nto check?' and a restrained one-line subtitle 'Technical answers for Series 76 actuators.' Below this, two compact outlined suggestion rows, not large cards: 'Look up a part number' and 'Find a matching actuator', with a thin right arrow. They fill the existing composer with a starter prompt, no separate feature. Bottom composer has empty placeholder and the send button is subdued disabled. Upper half balanced and lower half intentionally calm; no giant Conversations title and no New conversation full-width banner. The hamburger is a clear invitation to history. Make this look finished and mature, like a daily-used conversational assistant.
composition_scope: Single chat-first redesign shown in three states
